title: Finitely many minimal primes over an ideal in a Noetherian ring
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and let $I \subseteq R$ be an ideal. The set of prime ideals of $R$ that are minimal among those containing $I$ is finite.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00FR (lemma-Noetherian-irreducible-components), applied to Spec(R/I)
